comment: "I had heard of the term z-plasty before and knew it was used in lip reconstruction and pilonidal sinus but never thought about the specific angles to increase length etc. It was super cool to know. Also the model for physical simulation was really cool and easy to make."

"I found the precision and technique involved in Z-plasty, particularly in altering scar direction and improving functional and aesthetic outcomes, most interesting. The way small adjustments in angles can significantly impact scar healing and appearance was fascinating."

"The most interesting part was how Z-plasty design directly changes scar behavior. Seeing how adjusting limb angles (like 30–60°) and lengths actually affects tension, lengthening, and final scar orientation made it feel very practical, not just theory."

"I liked learning about the surgical precision in flap design and the geometric principles involved. Particularly how adjusting the angles between the central and lateral limbs directly influences the amount of lengthening to be particularly valuable."

"I enjoyed the sections on using different type of suture in the skin, anatomy of skin and identifying the vascularity of the skin. Very good look at practice and good visual and animation instructions."
"The course was very informative and engaging. I really enjoyed it and learned a lot. Thank you."
"I liked the interactive simulations and step-by-step decision making, especially performing a Z-plasty virtually from planning to execution."
"Great short course. I wish I had known of this site sooner."
